CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customer_wallet (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, wallet_unique_id VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL, company_id INT NOT NULL, branch_admin_id INT DEFAULT NULL, emp_id INT DEFAULT NULL, emp_type ENUM('SUPER_ADMIN','ADMIN','AGENT_ADMIN','AGENT','OVER_AGENT_ADMIN','OVER_AGENT') DEFAULT NULL, cus_id BIGINT NOT NULL, tran_id BIGINT DEFAULT NULL, beehive_id INT DEFAULT NULL, type ENUM('DEPOSIT','WITHDRAW','TRANSACTION') NOT NULL, sub_type ENUM('MONEY_TRANSFER','BEEHIVE_DEPOSIT') DEFAULT NULL, credit_in DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT NULL, credit_out DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT NULL, currency VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, date_added DATETIME NOT NULL, note VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL, location ENUM('DIRECT') DEFAULT NULL, is_approved ENUM('0','1') NOT NULL DEFAULT '1', idebit_issconf VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT NULL, idebit_issname VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT NULL, idebit_isstrack2 VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL, KEY company_id (company_id), KEY branch_admin_id (branch_admin_id), KEY emp_id (emp_id), KEY tran_id (tran_id), KEY beehive_id (beehive_id))
generation_sql: INSERT INTO customer_wallet (id, company_id, currency, is_approved, date_added) SELECT n, 1, '40', '1', DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL n DAY) FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= {row_count}

INSERT INTO customer_payment_options (id, wallet_id, payment_amount, real_account_type, source_country_id, ce_type) SELECT n, 1 + MOD(n, 100), ROUND(RAND() * 1000, 2), 'HQ', 40, CASE WHEN MOD(n, 2) = 0 THEN 'IN' ELSE 'OUT' END FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= {row_count}
